topic: How computers work from electricity to storage

scenes.description: Electricity from the wall outlet to a PC, through the power supply to the CPU
scenes.image: a laptop on a wooden desk

scenes.description: The CPU turns electricity into high voltage 1 and low voltage 0 and then binary values of 1s and 0s
scenes.image: a close-up of CPU on a motherboard

scenes.description: How an SSD stores bits as electrons
scenes.image: a close-up of a solid state drive SSD on a motherboard

scenes.description: How a hard drive stores bits as magnets
scenes.image: a close-up of an open hard disk drive with a spinning magnetic platter and read write head

scenes.description: How RAM, a temporary storage, sits between the fast CPU and slow storage and loses its data when the power is off
scenes.image: a close-up of a RAM memory module stick with memory chips on a motherboard
a close-up of SSD and hard disk drive
